question: The researcher's study focused on how early human societies developed their customs. Her work was:
explanation: anthropological: Relating to the study of human development.

reasons.B: Wrong: Relating to animals and their study.
reasons.C: Wrong: Diseased; relating to a disease.
reasons.D: Correct: Relating to the study of human development.

question: The scientist spent years living with tribes to study how human societies develop. She is an:
explanation: anthropologist: A scientist who studies human development.

reasons.A: Correct: A scientist who studies human development.
reasons.B: Wrong: A scientist who studies animal life.
reasons.C: Wrong: A scientist who studies the earth and its rocks.
reasons.D: Wrong: A student or expert of God and religion.

question: The course examined the study of human development, culture, and society across history. The subject is:
explanation: anthropology: The study of human development and culture.

reasons.A: Wrong: The science of animal life.
reasons.B: Correct: The study of human development and culture.
reasons.C: Wrong: The science of the earth's composition and history.
reasons.D: Wrong: The study of the mind and behavior.

question: He avoided every party and disliked people so much that he lived alone in the hills. He is a:
explanation: misanthrope: One who hates the human race.

reasons.A: Wrong: A person who gives money and time to help others.
reasons.B: Wrong: A person who hoards money and spends very little.
reasons.C: Correct: One who hates the human race.
reasons.D: Wrong: One who is interested in the welfare of others more than his own.

question: Her gloomy view of the world made her hate the entire human race and its ways. Her attitude was:

reasons.A: Wrong: Kind, well disposed, and wishing good for others.
reasons.C: Wrong: Showing concern for others; unselfish.

question: The writer declared that people were hopeless and that he despised mankind. He was a:
explanation: misanthropist: A person who hates mankind.

reasons.A: Correct: A person who hates mankind.
reasons.B: Wrong: A person who gives money and time to help others.
reasons.C: Wrong: A person who gives money or help to others.
reasons.D: Wrong: One who is interested in the welfare of others more than his own.

question: Her bitter views of the human race had grown into a deep, lasting hatred of people. This hatred is called:
explanation: misanthropy: Hatred of the human race.

reasons.A: Wrong: Love of mankind shown through giving.
reasons.B: Correct: Hatred of the human race.
reasons.C: Wrong: Concern for the welfare of others; selfless giving.
reasons.D: Wrong: A wish to do good for others.

question: The family set up a foundation that gave money generously to help the poor. Their giving was:

reasons.B: Wrong: Wishing evil or harm to others.
reasons.D: Wrong: Very sparing with money; stingy.

question: The businessman gave millions of dollars and years of his time to help people in need. He is a:
explanation: philanthropist: A person who gives money and time to help others.

reasons.A: Wrong: One who hates the human race.
reasons.B: Wrong: A person who hoards money and spends very little.
reasons.C: Wrong: A leader who stirs up discontent to win power.
reasons.D: Correct: A person who gives money and time to help others.

question: Many wealthy families pledge large parts of their fortunes to good causes that help people. This love of mankind shown through giving is:
explanation: philanthropy: Love of mankind shown through giving.

reasons.A: Correct: Love of mankind shown through giving.
reasons.B: Wrong: Hatred of the human race.
reasons.C: Wrong: Extreme care in spending; stinginess.
reasons.D: Wrong: Extreme poverty; lack of necessities.
